Salat-e-Mustaqeem

اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ

Prayer times, the Quran word by word, and a calm home that follows the sky. On your iPhone, Android phone, Apple Watch and Alexa.

Download on theApp Store
Get it onGoogle Play

Free · No ads · Works offline · English, العربية, اردو

☾
What’s new in 1.12.0

The Quran, illuminated

✦

A Mushaf you can read, study and memorise from, and a little Quran after every prayer.

An illuminated Mushaf

Read on Mushaf pages with ruled Hashiya lines, marks for ruku, rubʿ al-hizb, manzil and sajdah, and the opening words of each juz in gold.

Read, Words and Mushaf

Three ways into the same page: flowing text, every word with its meaning, or the printed Mushaf. Tap any word for its meaning and tajweed.

Quran after Salah

Finish the Quran a little after every prayer, in 7, 15, 30 or 60 days.

My Quran and Surah Info

Bookmarks, notes and collections in one place, and an introduction to every surah from Tafsir Ibn Kathir.

Ayah and Dua of the Day

The same ayah for the whole Ummah each day, now on your home and lock screen too, offline for a week.

Quran Radio and Share a verse

Continuous recitation from your favourite reciters, and any verse shared as a beautiful image.

The journey of 1.04 → 1.12.0

Ten releases in four weeks

On Google Play, a new version can take a few extra days to reach you while it’s reviewed.

1.04

October 17, 2026

The Athan in full, a watch app for Android, and the Quran without a connection.

iPhone · Experimental

Full Athan

On iOS 26, the complete Athan plays at each prayer, not a 30-second clip.

Wear OS

Galaxy Watch app

Tiles and complications that count down to the next prayer.

Quran

Surahs offline

Download whole surahs, or keep the ones you play. Manage them in Downloads & storage.

Quran

Reciter and translation in the player

Pick from 33 reciters and hear the translation with each surah.

Also in 1.04: a lock-screen countdown before each prayer on Android, app shortcuts, redesigned reminders, animated Namaz guides, and the app on Mac.

The Quran, word by word

Understand every word you recite

Tap any word to see what it means, how it is said and which tajweed rule applies. Listen as each ayah lights up, and pick up exactly where you left off.

✦

77,429 words with English and Urdu meanings and transliteration.

✦

Hear any single word, clipped from the recitation, even offline.

✦

Whole surahs offline, downloaded or kept as you listen, in Downloads & storage.

✦

Background listening with Lock Screen controls, speed and a sleep timer.

✦

30+ reciters, including Maher Al-Muaiqly, Husary, Abdul Basit and al-Tablawi.

✦

Continue reading at the exact ayah, and jump to any surah or juz by name.

Prayer, all day

Never miss a prayer

Your day as a sun dial, a home that follows the sky, and reminders that arrive on time, with the full Athan from the muezzin you choose.

✦

Full Athan reminders from seven muezzins, with a special Fajr Athan.

✦

Today’s prayer path: tap a prayer once you’ve prayed it, or add it to Qaḍāʾ.

✦

The full Athan on iPhone, beyond the 30-second limit, on iOS 26 (Experimental).

✦

Your own times: adjust any prayer and add a reminder before the Athan.

✦

Six home themes and a full dark mode, gentle on the eyes at Fajr.

✦

Travel-ready: times follow you to a new city, and work without a connection.

✦

Qibla compass that tells you which way to turn.

On the way

Coming soon

Built, and being tested before they reach your phone.

Coming soon

Tayyib: halal food scanner

Scan a barcode or the ingredient list and see at once whether it is halal, mashbooh or haram, which ingredient decided it, and how wholesome it is.

  • Every verdict shows its reason
  • E-Code Library, offline
  • Rulings follow your madhab
Coming soon

Sunnah: the Prophet’s words ﷺ for this moment

One authentic hadith chosen for the moment you are in, set like an illuminated page. Tell it how you feel, and it finds words from the Sunnah for you.

  • Only Sahih and Hasan, each with its grade and source
  • The chain of narrators, drawn as a thread of lamps
  • Arabic first, the translation one tap away
Coming soon

Muallim

Recite and a gentle teacher listens: madd lengths, ghunnah and ikhfāʾ, word by word.

Coming soon · Try it now

The Lamplighter

Help Taha and his kitten Misk light the city’s lanterns before Maghrib, and gather the beautiful Names of Allah along the way. A gentle game for children and grown-ups alike.

  • Light the city

    Run, jump and climb across rooftops to light every lantern before sunset.

  • A Lantern Book

    Each lantern holds a Name of Allah or a short reminder, kept in your book to read again.

  • Made for families

    No ads, no chat, no purchases. Calm, kind and safe for every age.

An early preview. The game is coming to the app’s Journey in a future update.

In the next release

The new Quran reader

ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ

A Mushaf you can read like the printed page, a word’s meaning one tap away, and your progress through the whole Quran.

Inside the reader

Study, keep and listen

The Quran becomes yours: verses read together, thoughts kept beside them, and recitation that carries on through your day.

١

Everything, one tap from the menu

Open the Quran menu and your study is waiting where you left it.

  • Compare

    The verses you pinned, side by side.

  • My Quran

    Your notes and collections in one place.

  • Bookmarks

    Every verse you marked, ready to reopen.

  • Reading history

    A calendar of the days you read, so the habit shows.

٢

Hold a verse, make it yours

Every verse carries its own actions. Keep a thought, gather verses by theme, read them together.

  • Pin to compare

    Pin up to three verses and read them side by side, with the words they share marked.

  • Add note

    Write your reflection under the verse. It waits in My Quran.

  • Save to collection

    Gather verses by theme: patience, mercy, du‘a, whatever you choose.

  • Share

    Send a verse to someone you love, from the share icon on every verse.

٣

Listen

Recitation that fits your day, from a single verse to a whole surah after another.

  • Quran Radio

    Whole surahs one after another: in order, at random, Juz ʿAmma or your favourites, with reciters shuffled or taking turns.

  • Quran audio

    Choose your reciter from samples, play verse after verse, hear the translation after each one, and have surah and juz endings announced.

Quran settings › Listening

Home-screen widgets

Everything inside

One app for your day of worship

✦

Athan reminders

Per-prayer Athan, beep or silent.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

✦

Times are calculated for your exact location. Choose the calculation method and the Asr school (Shafiʿi or Hanafi) that your masjid follows. When you travel, the times and the reminders follow you.

Yes. Prayer times are calculated on the phone when there is no connection, and the Quran text, word meanings and the ayahs you have listened to stay available offline.

Yes. Every feature is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. We believe prayer tools should be open to everyone.

iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later, Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later (it comes with the iPhone app), Android phones with Android 7.0 or later, and Galaxy Watch and other Wear OS watches (they come with the Android app).

On iPhone, touch and hold the Home Screen, tap Edit, then Add Widget, and search for Salat-e-Mustaqeem. On Android, touch and hold the home screen, tap Widgets and choose Salat-e-Mustaqeem. Pick Next Prayer, Today’s Prayers or Current Prayer.

The app is available in English, Arabic and Urdu (Settings → Language), with right-to-left layout. Word meanings are in English and Urdu, and Siri understands English and Arabic.

Yes, Muslim Companion. It plays the Athan on your Echo at every prayer, recites any surah, coaches your Hifz and keeps Ramadan. Say “Alexa, open Muslim Companion”.
